I’m sorry to hear about the difficulties you’ve experienced, especially given your pregnancy, and I want to clarify some points to hopefully address any misunderstandings.

Firstly, none of our standard appointments are booked a month in advance. Our prebookable appointments are generally available up to two weeks ahead. Occasionally, if a patient requests a specific doctor who is on annual leave, the next available slot may be beyond two weeks, which might have contributed to your initial experience.

Regarding urgent appointments, when patients express the need for an urgent consultation, our receptionists may advise calling back promptly at 8am, as this is when urgent slots are released. This helps us manage demand and ensure those with urgent needs are seen as quickly as possible.

I understand that missing your scheduled call was frustrating, and I’m sorry for the inconvenience caused by the missed connection and the delay in response. Unfortunately, for telephone consultations, it’s not always possible to offer an exact time frame for callbacks due to the unpredictable nature of a GP’s workload.

Please know that if you ever feel frustrated, dissatisfied, or that your concerns are not being heard, you are very welcome to ask the receptionist to forward your call to the practice manager directly. I am always available to assist and ensure your concerns are addressed promptly.

Your health and well-being, and that of your baby, are very important to us. We appreciate your patience and encourage you to reach out if you need further assistance.

Best wishes,
Practice
